findings.issue: רֵיקָם is an adverb of manner. vacíos is a plural adjective with mis faces, so emptiness is a property of the faces rather than the manner of the niphal being seen.
שֶׂה is a common-gender flock animal. cordero narrows it to a young male sheep.

notes: Person, number, the three פדה clauses, and the construct chains otherwise match the tokens.
